title: Chapter 6440: I Alone Am Immortal

Chapter 6440: I Alone Am Immortal

Chapter 6440: I Alone Am Immortal

In his mind, he wouldn’t have been an orphan without Desolate Ancestor. Moreover, he would have become a supreme overlord long ago. Now, her disciple blocked his way.

He restrained his hatred and said: “North Kun God, watch your ego. Today might be the start of your sect’s decline.”

He spoke confidently so this was not an empty threat.

“We will see what you have up your sleeve.” North Kun God said: “Come out, Trinity.”

North Kun God gave a different impression than the merciless origin ancestor. He resembled an immovable mountain but instead of being unreachable, his divinity was intimate. Despite being far stronger, those prostrating before him still felt he was one of them.

“Trinity?!” Everyone became startled.

“Buzz.” A heavenly kingdom appeared and within were three giants.

Their presence loomed over the dream world, causing desolate gods and emperors to bow down.

One of them pulsed with an immortal light, capable of turning mortal soil into immortal earth. Another had a devilish and mesmerizing fiery aura. It kept flowing inward, giving the impression of a bottomless abyss. The third had a mortal coil around him; one could sense the seven emotions and six desires of the world within. He contained the vitality, joy, and sadness of countless beings.

The third was the least impressive in terms of aura but possessed the most power and life force.

“Immortal, Devil, and Human.” An emperor murmured.

The trio was older than the origin ancestor. They once referred to Moshi as “brother” - a testament to their ancient prestige.

Although a few juniors have surpassed them, they were still among the strongest in Old World since they were in the eternal stage.

Since they were triplets, legend has it that fighting together greatly increased their battle prowess to the overlord level.

Today, the strongest characters in Old World have arrived. This surprised the spectators.

“What awaits at the source of the dream world? Everyone is here.” A desolate god said softly.

Their arrival in one place was unprecedented. Was this dream world worth it?

The three didn’t care for Gold Village or Paramount, only the source. There must be something here that was worthwhile for them.

“North Kun God, you are not in control.” Immortal’s voice was illusory with a reverberation.

“You are?” North Kun God took one step and appeared before the trio. No one else dared to talk to Trinity in this manner.

“You’ll find out soon.” Human was the least otherworldly being. His voice contained immense power, even more overbearing than North Kun God.

He was the strongest and the other two followed his lead.

“So be it, all of you at once then.” North Kun God formed a mudra and chanted: “To the north is a fish, the name is kun...”

“Boom!” A great Kun Peng flew out of his sleeve and grew to an unimaginable size. Its wings stretched across the dream world.

It possessed an innate gift, granting it enough power to tear the fabrics of reality.

“Go!” Trinity shouted in unison and released boundless primal energy.

“I alone am immortal.” Immortal became resplendent as he conjured his dao, summoning a great weapon.
